annotations.text: The reference dashboard's big panel is a 12-month performance line vs benchmarks. We have no portfolio history and no cost basis, so that slot holds cost-to-exit instead — same visual weight, real data, and nobody else publishes it.
The loop: hold → see what needs attention → open the asset → understand the rating → act with the cost on screen.
Every number here is measured from live data on 16 Sep: grades, components, prices, exit costs, the SILV advisory. Portfolio values are a sample wallet.
